title: Making Luck ep. 38 review: Witch, Silk Road, Fountain, Colonnade, Pooka

sources.author: Adam Horton and Jake
sources.note: Making Luck ep. 38, review of the ep. 37 kingdom, 5:32-15:50; games played

sources.author: WanderingWinder, Adam Horton, listeners
sources.note: original https://adamhorton.com/flog/forum/topic/making-luck-episode-37-when-theres-no-x/ (offline); pre-review discussion the hosts credit

quality_note: Hosts played the board and agree on a Witch slog for Fountain, Silk Road and Colonnade points; WanderingWinder's forum analysis broadly matches. Cursed Gold usage is disputed.

kingdom.setup_notes: Pooka's Heirloom: each player starts with a Cursed Gold in place of one Copper. Baker's setup: each player starts with 1 Coffers. Familiar costs a Potion, so Potion is in the Supply.

edition: Kingdom from Adam Horton's ep. 37 description. Uses first-edition Silk Road and Mandarin (removed in Hinterlands second edition). Colonies not mentioned.
